author: Hermes
question: In the two-wattmeter method for a balanced three-phase load, the readings are W1 = 2000 W and W2 = 1000 W. What is the total three-phase power?
solution: Total power = W1 + W2 = 2000 + 1000 = 3000 W. Topic (power measurement) is in the Measurements section of the official GATE 2027 EE syllabus. Source checked: https://gate2027.iitm.ac.in/static/doc/GATE2027_Syllabus/EE_GATE2027_Syllabus.pdf
subject: Measurements
